parallel.requirements: Recognized the complete GraphNeuralNetwork package requirements: GCN, GAT, GraphSAGE, data preprocessing, utilities, training/evaluation, setup.py, docs, examples, and tests.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent owned implementation directly, then delegated a late read-only audit workflow to eleven specialized children for API, examples, packaging, training quality, robustness, docs, and edge cases.
parallel.implementation: Created many package files including config.py, utils.py, _common.py, gcn.py, gat.py, graphsage.py, run scripts, setup.py, README, license, and several tests; child audits later exposed training/serialization defects.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The workspace artifact contained a broad package tree, but the run timed out before final response or submit-loop closure and before audit results could be integrated.
parallel.verification: Parent ran several spec examples and launched exhaustive child audits; children produced partial useful findings such as GCN fit accuracy 0.162 and PoolingAggregator load failure, but no aggregate workflow result returned.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Process returncode 143, timeout true, final response empty, official evaluation 0/4 failed; the last parent action was still writing tests while audit children remained active.

serial.requirements: Received the same full package requirements but only acted on environment checks and data acquisition before stopping.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single parent, no delegation, no subagents, no workflow use; local ownership never progressed from setup/probing into source implementation.
serial.implementation: Downloaded raw Cora and Planetoid datasets and copied them into /workspace/data/cora while creating empty gnn/tests directories; no setup.py or module files were present in the artifact.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No package integration or deliverable assembly occurred; artifact validation listed only data/cora files.
serial.verification: Only environment and dataset checks ran; no package tests, model training, or submit-aligned verification happened before closure.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Returned normally after about 257 seconds but final text was just a prototyping note and official evaluation had 0/4 passed with 3 errors.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child handoffs or interface boundaries; it only used local observations and downloads.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel created child-result context that never returned; serial lacked that boundary but also lacked implementation progress.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Wrote config, utils, common helpers, GCN, GAT, GraphSAGE, API exports, run scripts, setup.py, docs, and tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Downloaded and copied Cora/Planetoid data but wrote no visible source implementation before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel produced a large but flawed implementation; serial produced essentially only data assets.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow launched in background and was killed with result null and all child auditors still in progress.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: No child result lifecycle existed; the local run ended after its last prototyping statement.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost a delegated verifier lifecycle; serial failed by premature local stop rather than by unreturned child results.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent kept writing workspace files while read-only children copied/read the same workspace; one child noticed concurrent population and re-snapshotted.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial workspace artifact contains only downloaded data files and no concurrent shared-state activity.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had concurrent read/copy exposure but no proven write collision; serial had no shared-workspace concurrency.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent ran several spec examples and launched many auditors; child findings later showed hidden quality gaps but were not returned to parent before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial did no meaningful package verification because no package implementation was produced.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel performed partial and overbroad verification that failed to close the loop; serial had effectively no implementation acceptance loop.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full 2400-second budget, timed out, and left an empty final response after 11 live workflow children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial returned normally after about 257 seconds with no subagents, but its artifact was incomplete.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closure was dominated by fan-out timeout; serial closure was early local incompletion.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current official evaluations failed. Parallel produced a much larger implementation and partial verification but timed out after an overbroad audit workflow, while serial stopped after data setup without source code. The shared outcome is both_fail, so the retained parallel pattern is an adverse process difference rather than an outcome-differential root cause.
parallel_contributors: Late 11-child audit fan-out exhausted the remaining run budget and prevented child verifier findings from returning to the parent.

The implementation still had ordinary quality defects, including poor Keras fit accuracy reported by the training-quality child and PoolingAggregator serialization trouble reported by the usage child.
serial_contributors: Serial did not implement the package source, setup.py, or tests; it ended after dataset preparation.
Serial had no delegation or workflow lifecycle issue; its failure was ordinary incompletion.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel artifact had many source and test files but failed official tests; serial artifact contained only data files.
Parallel child evidence indicates a Keras fit path quality defect separate from coordination, while serial had no model code to evaluate.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: Both fail; fan-out is a supported parallel adverse process contributor, not an exclusive root cause or discordant-outcome explanation.

retained_patterns.reason: The parent chose a broad 11-child audit while still near closure. The workflow state records a killed workflow with no aggregate result, all children still in progress, and large child token/tool usage; the process then timed out. That concrete breadth displaced final correction and acceptance rather than being a harmless audit.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The aggregate audit never returned, useful child findings were unavailable to the parent, and the parallel run closed under timeout with an empty final response.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The missing verifier return was the terminal symptom of the same overbroad fan-out; the retained label captures the direct allocation boundary.
